when.t: A discovery in a monitored zip code gives a representation status that is not one of listed, expired, FSBO or unknown.

steps.t: Agent 19 records it as unknown, with the source and the retrieval date, and passes the record to the authorized user.
Discoveries outside the monitored zip codes are not recorded.
Agent 19 fetches nothing: a discovery reaches it only as an incoming message.
Agent 19 never contacts anyone; it has no route to a prospect.

never.t: Guess whether the property is represented.

you_see.t: A prospect record marked representation unknown, with its source.

test.t: Zip 44101 is monitored. A new listing from the MLS expired feed arrives with representation "maybe still listed?".

title.t: A discovery comes from an unapproved source

when.t: An expired or FSBO discovery comes from a source not on the authorized user's approved list.

steps.t: Agent 19 does not use it and tells the authorized user the source was excluded.
The approved list is a signed setting; only expired and FSBO discoveries are checked against it.

never.t: Use a source whose compliance is unclear.

you_see.t: A note that the source was excluded.

test.t: An expired listing from "scraped-forum", which is not approved.

title.t: A prospect is already a client

when.t: A discovery is marked as matching a client on the authorized user's known-client list.

steps.t: Agent 19 tells the authorized user about the relationship and still passes the record on; it implies no outreach.
The match is a mark on the incoming discovery; Agent 19 does not work it out.

never.t: Treat the client as a cold prospect.

you_see.t: A note naming the existing client, and the prospect record.

test.t: B1 is on the known-client list; a discovery marked as matching B1 arrives.

title.t: An expired listing relists with another broker

when.t: A discovery for a recorded expired listing says it relisted with another broker.

steps.t: Agent 19 marks the opportunity closed and logs it.

never.t: Keep pursuing a listing another broker now holds.

you_see.t: The opportunity closed in the history.

test.t: P1 arrives expired, then again relisted with Other Realty.

title.t: Someone tells Agent 19 to contact prospects in bulk

when.t: An instruction to contact prospects in bulk arrives.

steps.t: Unsigned, the dispatcher refuses it before Agent 19 sees it.
Signed, Agent 19 notes it and still contacts no one.
Agent 19 never contacts anyone; it has no route to a prospect.

never.t: Take a chat message as authority.

you_see.t: A refusal on the audit log; nothing sent.

test.t: "text every expired owner in 44101 today", first unsigned, then signed.

when.t: An expired listing from an approved source is discovered in a monitored zip code.

steps.t: Agent 19 raises a legal-line alert: a person and Compliance decide before any contact.
It passes the record to the authorized user.
Agent 19 never contacts anyone; it has no route to a prospect.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert and the prospect record.

test.t: P1, expired, from the MLS expired feed in 44101.

when.t: An FSBO listing from an approved source is discovered in a monitored zip code.

steps.t: Agent 19 raises the same legal-line alert as for an expired listing.
It passes the record to the authorized user.
Agent 19 never contacts anyone; it has no route to a prospect.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert and the prospect record.

test.t: P1, FSBO, from the licensed FSBO portal in 44101.

title.t: A prospect is on the do-not-call list

when.t: A discovery's owner contact matches the authorized user's do-not-call list (phone numbers compared as digits).

steps.t: Agent 19 logs it as suppressed by rule.
The record still goes to the authorized user, marked on the do-not-call list.
The list is a signed setting.

never.t: Treat a do-not-call prospect as contactable.

you_see.t: The prospect record marked on the do-not-call list.

test.t: (330) 555-0190 is on the list; a discovery with owner contact 330-555-0190.

title.t: A ranking has a weak basis

when.t: A discovery carries a rank whose basis strength is below the threshold (0.5 unless the discovery gives one).

steps.t: Agent 19 leaves the rank out and says why; the data stays.
The rank and its basis come on the incoming discovery; Agent 19 ranks nothing itself.

never.t: Show a rank without a basis.

you_see.t: The prospect marked unranked, with the reason.

test.t: A rank of 0.9 with basis strength 0.2.

title.t: Farm outreach asks for household-level data

when.t: The authorized user's farm data request asks for individual household data.

steps.t: Agent 19 refuses and raises a legal-line alert.
An area-level request is answered with one note to the authorized user: no neighborhood data source is connected, so there is nothing to aggregate (owner decision of 2026-10-28).
Nothing is asked of Agent 10: it has no data source of its own and builds packages only from figures it is handed, so before 2026-10-28 the package that came back was always empty.

you_see.t: A legal-line alert for the household request; a note that no neighborhood data source is connected for the area request.

test.t: A farm request for 44101 at household level, then one at area level.
